import sys

MOD = 1000000007
INV100 = pow(100, MOD - 2, MOD)

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    a = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            val = next(it)
            a[i][j] = val * INV100 % MOD

    # states: dict mapping tuple of masks (sorted) to probability
    states = {(0,): 1}
    all_mask = (1 << n) - 1

    for col in range(n):
        # precompute prob for each mask in this column
        prob_mask = [1] * (1 << n)
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            p = 1
            for row in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << row):
                    p = p * a[row][col] % MOD
                else:
                    p = p * (1 - a[row][col]) % MOD
            prob_mask[mask] = p

        new_states = {}
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            prob = prob_mask[mask]
            if prob == 0:
                continue
            for vec_tuple, state_prob in states.items():
                new_set = set()
                for m2 in vec_tuple:
                    possible = (all_mask ^ m2) & mask
                    while possible:
                        bit = possible & -possible
                        new_set.add(m2 | bit)
                        possible ^= bit
                if new_set:
                    new_vec = tuple(sorted(new_set))
                    new_states[new_vec] = (new_states.get(new_vec, 0) + state_prob * prob) % MOD
        states = new_states

    ans = sum(states.values()) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
